blurb: Downtown Yoga Shala offers a variety of yoga classes including Ashtanga, Vinyasa Flow, Yin, Restorative, Power Yoga, and Sound Healing. They provide Mysore-style Ashtanga practice and teacher training programs. Reformer Pilates classes are also available with different levels and equipment.
